newsitem.title: GERMANY: RWE-DEA forecasts higher earnings for 96/97.
newsitem.headline: RWE-DEA forecasts higher earnings for 96/97.

text.p: RWE-DEA AG, the petroleum and chemical unit of diversified energy group RWE AG, said on Thursday that it expected slightly higher earnings in its 1996/97 business year.
The oil group said lower costs would allow it to report higher earnings overall in the year to the end of June 1997.
The group reported lower pre-tax profits of 133.2 million marks in the six months to the end of December 1996, down from 145.1 million marks the previous year.
RWE-DEA's petroleum processing and sales business saw positive development in the first half, while margins in its refinery business also improved during the period.
The group said earnings in its petrochemical and chemical divisions were lower than in the previous year, because of higher costs and lower sales revenues from certain chemical products.
The group said its payroll numbers were stable at 8,518 employees.
